title: Chameleon with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='eyeG' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD23F'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail curl -->
  <path d='M22 62 C10 62 8 48 18 44 C27 40 32 50 24 53 C19 55 18 49 22 48' fill='none' stroke='#2FA84F' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#3CCB63'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='19' ry='8' fill='#7BE89A'/>
  <!-- back ridge -->
  <path d='M30 43 L36 36 L42 42 L50 34 L58 41 L66 34 L72 42' fill='none' stroke='#1E8A3C' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <path d='M56 70 C55 78 52 82 47 84' fill='none' stroke='#2FA84F' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 86 L51 86 M47 83 L47 89' stroke='#2FA84F' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M30 70 C30 78 33 82 38 84' fill='none' stroke='#2FA84F' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 86 L42 86 M38 83 L38 89' stroke='#2FA84F' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='15' fill='#3CCB63'/>
  <!-- head crest -->
  <path d='M62 36 C68 28 78 28 84 36' fill='#1E8A3C'/>
  <!-- casque highlight -->
  <path d='M65 33 C70 30 77 30 81 34' fill='none' stroke='#7BE89A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M74 54 C79 56 85 55 87 51' fill='none' stroke='#1E8A3C' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='44' r='7' fill='url(#eyeG)' stroke='#1E8A3C' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#123F1E'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M66 38 L67 41 L70 42 L67 43 L66 46 L65 43 L62 42 L65 41 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M80 34 L80.8 36.2 L83 37 L80.8 37.8 L80 40 L79.2 37.8 L77 37 L79.2 36.2 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#1E8A3C'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#1E8A3C'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='55' r='2' fill='#1E8A3C'/>
</svg>
